long.vo: In a format built to destroy bowlers, जसप्रीत बुमराह concedes less than six runs an over at T20 World Cups. Five point six six, across forty wickets. That number shouldn't be possible.

Put it in context. In IPL twenty twenty-five, batting teams scored at more than nine an over. Through twenty twenty-five, बुमराह's IPL career economy was seven point two seven. And on the World Cup stage, five point six six.

And he saves his best for the biggest stage. He was player of the tournament when India won the twenty twenty-four World Cup. Then in twenty twenty-six, he took fourteen wickets, including four for fifteen in the final, as India defended their title on home soil.

tiles.l: WICKETS · 2024 WORLD CUP · PLAYER OF THE TOURNAMENT

long.vo: So how does he do it? It starts with the action. A short, stuttering run-up and a whippy, hyper-extended arm that releases the ball closer to the batter than almost anyone else. Batters get less time to pick it. Then add a yorker he can land on demand, a slower ball that comes out of the same action, and nerves that don't change at the death.

items.d: Short run-up, whippy arm, late release: less time to pick it
The ball arrives sooner than batters expect
Lands it at the death, ball after ball

long.vo: Which makes twenty twenty-six so strange. In the IPL, बुमराह took just four wickets in thirteen matches, at an average of over a hundred. Early in the season, he went a hundred and twenty-two balls without a wicket, the longest drought of his IPL career.

tiles.l: BALLS WITHOUT A WICKET: HIS LONGEST DROUGHT

long.vo: What went wrong? Part of it is workload. He'd just carried India through a World Cup. Part of it is the batting revolution, with run rates at record highs. And part of it was Mumbai. With little support at the other end, batters simply waited him out and attacked everyone else. Even so, early in the season, he was the only Mumbai bowler conceding under nine an over.

items.d: Straight from carrying India through a World Cup
Record run rates across the IPL
Batters waited him out and attacked the rest
Early on, Mumbai's only bowler under 9 an over

long.vo: Our verdict? A bad IPL season, not a decline. In March, he was the best bowler at a World Cup. And now, with अर्शदीप सिंह joining him at Mumbai, he finally has help at the other end.

scene.sub: With Arshdeep joining him at Mumbai, he finally has help at the other end.

long.vo: Is बुमराह the greatest T20 bowler ever? Tell us in the comments, and subscribe for more.

short.vo: जसप्रीत बुमराह concedes five point six six an over at T20 World Cups.
In the IPL, teams now score at more than nine an over.
In the twenty twenty-six final, he took four for fifteen.
Then his IPL went quiet: four wickets in thirteen games.
A bad season. Not a decline.
